title: Two-Person Adversarial Test Gap Catalog across 97 Derivation DAG Nodes

claim_hygiene_summary.supports: A structured catalog of missing unit, integration, end-to-end, and mutation tests across all 97 derivation DAG nodes, identifying formal soundness limitations, unstated boundaries, check script assertion deficits, mechanization inflation, admission chain bypasses, and disconnected bridge obligations.
claim_hygiene_summary.does_not_support: Any implementation of new test suites (strictly precluded by Milestone 4), any assertion that cataloging substitutes for empirical test execution, or any claim that toy-model checks establish continuum physics or general domain properties.
claim_hygiene_summary.narrowest_defensible_claim: The derivation DAG contains 71 unconditionally perfected, 3 conditionally perfected, and 23 non-perfected nodes; 45 nodes lack standalone executable Python simulation (binding only to Lean meta-validation scripts), 3 check scripts in audit/ contain zero assertions, and 51 of 56 derived nodes drop transitive admission dependencies.
claim_hygiene_summary.next_test_needed: Execution of prioritized unit and integration test suites during downstream test engineering cycles, restoration of the Trotter char poly calculator in DER-49, hardening of zero-assertion audit check scripts, and explicit transitive wiring of open bridge admissions.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Zero-Assertion and Superficial Check Scripts in Audit Suite
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: Three of the seven audit check scripts in audit/2026-11-05_minimal_chain/ (2_mark_checks.py, 4_frozen_checks.py, 5_forcing_checks.py) contain exactly zero assert statements, exception raises, or non-zero exit codes. They execute print statements and terminate with exit code 0 unconditionally. For example, 2_mark_checks.py:246-273 computes soundness_holds = all(...), prints the boolean to stdout, and exits with code 0 even if the invariant evaluates to False. Script 9_oq01_to_oq04_checks.py has only 1 assertion across 266 lines, and 3_regime_deletions.py has only 2 superficial 'is not None' checks across 476 lines.
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: Validation via scripts/validate_derivation_dag.py --run-checks reports false green success, masking runtime invariant breakages as successful runs.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Convert all stdout print checks into explicit boolean assertions and structured exceptions that exit with non-zero status upon evaluation failure.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Mechanization Facet Inflation in WDP Layer 6 and Host Admissions
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: Exactly 26 nodes (host admission OWE-01 and 25 derived nodes in WDP Layer 6: DER-31, DER-32, DER-34 through DER-56) declare python_checks restricted to scripts/check_primitive_difference.py and scripts/check_admission_replay.py. These scripts only verify Lean toolchain compilation hashes and inspect #print axioms. There is zero executable Python code performing numerical simulation or runtime property testing for discrete Gauss-Bonnet splits (DER-53), cochain window trichotomy (DER-54), pentachoron monopoles (DER-55), rooted tree gauge normalization (DER-47), sparse chain transport norms (DER-48), or primal-dual repair quotients (DER-50, DER-51).
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: 24 of the 52 nodes classified as PERFECTED in the tri-partite correspondence audit have never been executed or tested in Python; their mechanization facet is administrative meta-validation rather than behavioral execution.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Author dedicated Python calculation modules and property-based test suites in tests/ covering each mathematical structure in WDP Layer 6.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Missing Response Matrix Calculator in Trotter Characteristic Polynomials (DER-49)
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: The header of lean/WitnessedDifference/TrotterCharPoly.lean (lines 11-14) states: 'This file does not build the response matrix and does not derive a characteristic polynomial. The Python module code/trotter_characteristic_polynomials.py is the calculator for those matrices.' However, code/trotter_characteristic_polynomials.py does not exist in omega_codex, and the code/ directory is completely absent. All 33 theorems in TrotterCharPoly.lean only evaluate constant fraction identities of the form a * num - b * den = 0 via rfl (e.g., evalCleared 21 10 m1_root_pos1 = 0 checks 21*10 - 10*21 = 0).
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: DER-49 is cataloged as PERFECTED, but its declared computational calculator was never integrated into omega_codex.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Port code/trotter_characteristic_polynomials.py from reference Repository B into scripts/ or a dedicated package, and bind dedicated unit tests in tests/.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Integer Linear Arithmetic Substitutions in Discrete Gauss-Bonnet (DER-53) and Cohomology (DER-55)
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: In DiscreteGaussBonnet.lean:201-206, discrete_gauss_bonnet_triangulated_surface is a 4-variable integer linear identity 6*V - sumK = 6*(V - E + F) discharged in one step by the integer linear arithmetic tactic omega from hypotheses 2*E = 3*F and sumK = 2*E. There is no triangulated geometric surface, curvature form, or boundary operator. In HigherSimplicialCohomology.lean, Euler characteristics are proven by 'by decide' on static integer arithmetic expressions ((4:Int) - 6 + 4 = 2, (6:Int) - 12 + 8 = 2, (5:Int) - 10 + 10 - 5 = 0) on single Platonic simplices.
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: Mathematical prose discusses continuum Regge calculus and General Relativity, whereas formal proofs operate strictly on static integer arithmetic expressions over single small graphs.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Implement generic simplicial mesh data structures and boundary operators in Python and Lean to verify deficit angle sums on non-equilateral and multi-cell meshes.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Memoryless Refusal Register in Primitive Difference (DER-01)
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: In lean/PrimitiveDifference.lean:166-168, def recordRefusal (c : Bool -> Bool) (_previous : Register) : Register := ⟨reject c⟩ discards the _previous register state completely. The refusal register is a stateless boolean wrapper evaluating an instantaneous function equality rather than accumulating operational history or state transitions.
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: Downstream prose describes cumulative refusal tracking, whereas the formalized code implements a stateless check.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Formalize stateful refusal registers accumulating historical candidate maps over input sequences, with tests verifying persistence across sequential updates.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Admission Chain Bypasses and Transitive Admission Dropping
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: (1) DER-22 is marked DERIVED_CONDITIONALLY on open bridge OWE-08. DER-49 derives directly from DER-22, yet DER-49 is classified as unconditionally PERFECTED without inheriting OWE-08 or an incoming admission edge. (2) 51 of 56 DERIVED nodes drop transitive OWED admission dependencies from their unpriced_inputs_or_admissions (such as OWE-02 S1-S3 substrate, declared only on DER-01 and DER-02).
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: Downstream derivations appear unconditionally established despite depending transitively on open bridge debts or unpriced foundational admissions.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Compute transitive closures of admission dependencies during DAG validation and propagate open bridge debts downstream.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Disconnected Open Bridge Obligations in Derivation DAG
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: Open bridge obligations OWE-05 (diamond-to-root gap), OWE-06 (genesis-to-window gap), and OWE-10 (infinite completion) have zero outgoing edges in dag/derivation_dag.json. Downstream nodes bypass them completely by assuming restricted finite carriers without explicit graph dependency edges.
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: The DAG topology masks open foundational debts by isolating bridge nodes rather than explicitly wiring them to consumers.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Connect open bridge obligations to their downstream recipient nodes with explicit requires_admission or motivates_bridge edges.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Toy-Model Cost Restrictions in Replay Commutation (DER-12, DER-28, DER-33)
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: Commutation between HWorld and Represented.World is evaluated strictly at zero admission and retention cost (cSup = 0, cAdm = 0, cRet = 0, cEv = 1) and singleton views. Non-zero costs, multi-locus views, and non-trivial memory limits remain untested in executable code.
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: Commutation and replay properties are verified only under degenerate zero-cost conditions, leaving behavior under non-zero costs unexamined.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Author property-based simulation suites sweeping across non-zero cost vectors and multi-locus configurations.

systemic_vulnerabilities.title: Scale Divergence between Mathematical Prose and Constructive Formalization
systemic_vulnerabilities.description: Mathematical prose documents employ terminology from continuous physics, differential geometry, and quantum field theory (e.g., Einstein-Hilbert action, Regge calculus, cosmological horizons, quantum state spaces), whereas formal code implements strictly discrete, finite combinatorial structures (e.g., Bool, Fin 3, single Platonic solids, hardcoded fractions).
systemic_vulnerabilities.epistemic_impact: Creates semantic inflation where readers may confuse toy combinatorial models with continuous physical theories.
systemic_vulnerabilities.remediation: Align mathematical prose strictly with finite discrete structures and explicitly label all continuum descriptions as non-formalized conjectures.
